info.name: CyberSource Merged Spec bankAccountValidation Payment Links API
Get a List of Payment Links

params.name: limit
params.description:
Maximum number of items you would like returned. 

Maximum limit: 1000

params.name: status
params.description:
The status of the purchase or donation link.

Possible values:
  - ACTIVE
  - INACTIVE

items.docs:
Provides a (filtered) list of payment links that have been created in your account.
You can filter the list based on the following status types:
 - ACTIVE
 - INACTIVE

Pay by Link is an easy and fast way to securely sell products or receive
donations online. This solution is ideal for distributing the same
payment link to multiple customers. 

Links for making purchases are referred to as fixed-price links, and
links for making donations are referred to as customer-set price links.
You can retrieve details of a specific payment link. For each payment transaction you can use the Transaction Details API to get more details on the payment transaction.

You can update all information except the payment link number for a
payment link. Changes made to amount/price will apply to new payments
made using the payment link.
